card.statement:
Let $G$ be a reductive group. The generalized Beilinson–Drinfeld Grassmannian is the space $\mathrm{Gr}_{G|S,S^{\prime}}$ given by isomorphism classes of triples $\{(x,\mathcal{P},\phi)\}$ of $x\in X^{S}$ , $\mathcal{P}$ a principal $G$ -bundle over $\Delta_{S}(x)$ , and $\phi$ a trivialization of $\mathcal{P}$ over $\Delta_{S}^{S^{\prime}}(x)$ .

The construction of such a space as a fpqc-quotient of an inductive limit of “homogeneous” spaces (generalizing the description of the affine Grassmannian as a $G(\!(z)\!)$ -homogeneous space) is given in [Lon21, Section 3.5], where it is denoted $G_{S}^{S^{\prime}}/G_{S}$ .
card.label: Definition 3.17

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
